### Johns Hopkins Healthcare System (JHHS) connects the patient experience

Records system and Contact Center in inventive ways that drive more personal, efficient and
satisfying patient experiences.

[ Read the story ][64]
[Aflac logo]

### By combining empathy with ease, Aflac raises the experience bar

Aflac deploys innovative Avaya technologies including AI agent assist to increase ease of
interaction and decrease handling time for customers facing stressful life events and the Aflac
employees working hard to support them.

[ Read the story ][65]
[Konecta logo]

### Florida State University (FSU) strengthens global university community

FSU taps Avaya’s flexible solutions to integrate and transition disparate, geographically
distributed systems to the cloud, accelerating the university’s vision for a more unified, simple
communications environment that better connects and serves its community.

[ Read the story ][66]
[Access Bank logo]

### Access Bank leverages Avaya technology to double its customer base by 2027

The bank uses an Avaya hybrid system combining on-prem for voice, video banking, routing, and
analytics with cloud for digital channels and chatbot integration, creating a unified customer
engagement platform.

[ Read the story ][67]

## We deliver future-ready solutions for organizations that demand innovation and reliability
* Contact Center solutions
* Critical Communications solutions
* Unified Communications solutions

Contact Center solutions

## Create seamless customer experiences across all channels

Connect with customers wherever they are—phone, chat, email, social—all from one platform.
Orchestrate end-to-end customer journeys that blend AI, self-service, and live assistance to forge
unbreakable customer bonds. 

[ Explore CC solutions ][68]

Critical Communications solutions

## Resilient voice infrastructure for environments that cannot fail

Establish a secure, zero-downtime voice architecture—ideal for regulated environments where
mission-critical communications underpin safety, compliance, and operational continuity.

collaboration and drive business agility at scale.

efficiently, and at global scale.

troubleshooting, learning, automation, and agent-driven guidance to power Cisco support and
professional services.

[Popular Science of Construction Suspended Platforms: Efficient Equipment for Exterior Wall
Construction][173]

Construction suspended platforms are core aerial equipment for exterior wall construction,
renovation and maintenance, curtain wall installation, anti-corrosion and thermal insulation
projects, serving as an effective alternative to traditional scaffolding. Featuring easy assembly
and disassembly, lightweight flexibility and strong adaptability, they are widely used in high-rise
buildings, municipal projects and old building renovation, greatly improving the efficiency and
safety of high-altitude operations. Many construction workers use suspended platforms frequently on
a daily basis, yet lack sufficient understanding of their structural features, model differences and
maintenance specifications. This article introduces basic knowledge of suspended platforms, helping
practitioners select models scientifically, standardize operations and conduct proper equipment
maintenance.     1. Basic Structure and Working Principle of Suspended Platforms Electric suspended
platforms adopt a modular combined structure, which is easy to disassemble, transport and assemble,
adapting to various complex exterior wall construction scenarios. The complete equipment mainly
consists of a suspension mechanism, counterweight system, hanging platform, lifting mechanism,
safety protection devices and electrical control system. The coordination of all systems ensures
stable and safe equipment operation. It adopts a mature and reliable working principle: fixed by the
roof suspension mechanism and counterweights, equipped with working steel ropes and safety steel
ropes, the lifting machine drives the hanging platform to lift vertically, providing a stable
operating surface for high-altitude work. Compared with traditional scaffolding, suspended platforms
require no large-area erection and are not limited by building shapes and floor heights, especially
suitable for special-shaped and curved exterior wall construction. Equipped with multiple protection
structures including fall arrest safety locks, limit devices, power-off and leakage protection, the
equipment adopts dual mechanical and electronic control protection, effectively avoiding risks such
as over-speed, tilting and falling, making it a reliable safety equipment for high-altitude exterior
wall construction.     2.Main Model Classification and Application Scenarios Suspended platforms are
divided into various models according to driving modes, specifications and load capacities to adapt
to different construction conditions. Reasonable model selection can effectively reduce costs and
improve efficiency. As the mainstream on-site model, electric suspended platforms feature stable
operation, simple operation and high efficiency, suitable for exterior wall painting, thermal
insulation, curtain wall installation, renovation and maintenance of high-rise residential and
commercial buildings. Manual suspended platforms are lightweight and power-free, mostly used for
low-rise repairs, minor maintenance and power-off emergency scenarios. The widely used ZLP630
standard suspended platform features high stability and moderate load capacity, and can be equipped
with platforms of different lengths for large-area exterior wall construction. Compared with
scaffolding, it has a short erection cycle, flexible movement and small floor space, which can
effectively shorten the construction period and save construction costs. Meanwhile, suspended
platforms are also widely applied in special infrastructure scenarios such as bridge anti-corrosion,
tank inspection, chimney maintenance and large venue renovation.     3. Standard Operation and Basic
Maintenance Guidelines As high-frequency aerial work equipment, suspended platforms are prone to
steel rope wear, accessory aging and electrical system moisture damage after long-term outdoor
operation. Standardized operation and regular maintenance are the key to eliminating hidden dangers
and extending equipment service life. Basic daily inspection is required before operation: check the
stability of suspension mechanisms and counterweights, whether steel ropes are rusted or broken, the
sensitivity of safety locks, brakes and limit devices, and the integrity of platform bolts and
welds. Faulty equipment is prohibited from operation. Operators must strictly follow load standards,
overloading, eccentric loading and platform shaking are forbidden, and work shall be suspended in
strong wind weather. Daily maintenance focuses on wearing parts: regularly lubricate hoists and
transmission structures, clean dust on steel ropes and conduct anti-rust treatment; check the
waterproof and moisture-proof performance of circuits after rain or during idle periods to prevent
electric leakage and short circuits. Regular daily maintenance can effectively reduce failure rates

[Popular Science of Construction Suspended Platforms: Efficient Equipment for Exterior Wall
Construction][173]

Construction suspended platforms are core aerial equipment for exterior wall construction,
renovation and maintenance, curtain wall installation, anti-corrosion and thermal insulation
projects, serving as an effective alternative to traditional scaffolding. Featuring easy assembly
and disassembly, lightweight flexibility and strong adaptability, they are widely used in high-rise
buildings, municipal projects and old building renovation, greatly improving the efficiency and
safety of high-altitude operations. Many construction workers use suspended platforms frequently on
a daily basis, yet lack sufficient understanding of their structural features, model differences and
maintenance specifications. This article introduces basic knowledge of suspended platforms, helping
practitioners select models scientifically, standardize operations and conduct proper equipment
maintenance.     1. Basic Structure and Working Principle of Suspended Platforms Electric suspended
platforms adopt a modular combined structure, which is easy to disassemble, transport and assemble,
adapting to various complex exterior wall construction scenarios. The complete equipment mainly
consists of a suspension mechanism, counterweight system, hanging platform, lifting mechanism,
safety protection devices and electrical control system. The coordination of all systems ensures
stable and safe equipment operation. It adopts a mature and reliable working principle: fixed by the
roof suspension mechanism and counterweights, equipped with working steel ropes and safety steel
ropes, the lifting machine drives the hanging platform to lift vertically, providing a stable
operating surface for high-altitude work. Compared with traditional scaffolding, suspended platforms
require no large-area erection and are not limited by building shapes and floor heights, especially
suitable for special-shaped and curved exterior wall construction. Equipped with multiple protection
structures including fall arrest safety locks, limit devices, power-off and leakage protection, the
equipment adopts dual mechanical and electronic control protection, effectively avoiding risks such
as over-speed, tilting and falling, making it a reliable safety equipment for high-altitude exterior
wall construction.     2.Main Model Classification and Application Scenarios Suspended platforms are
divided into various models according to driving modes, specifications and load capacities to adapt
to different construction conditions. Reasonable model selection can effectively reduce costs and
improve efficiency. As the mainstream on-site model, electric suspended platforms feature stable
operation, simple operation and high efficiency, suitable for exterior wall painting, thermal
insulation, curtain wall installation, renovation and maintenance of high-rise residential and
commercial buildings. Manual suspended platforms are lightweight and power-free, mostly used for
low-rise repairs, minor maintenance and power-off emergency scenarios. The widely used ZLP630
standard suspended platform features high stability and moderate load capacity, and can be equipped
with platforms of different lengths for large-area exterior wall construction. Compared with
scaffolding, it has a short erection cycle, flexible movement and small floor space, which can
effectively shorten the construction period and save construction costs. Meanwhile, suspended
platforms are also widely applied in special infrastructure scenarios such as bridge anti-corrosion,
tank inspection, chimney maintenance and large venue renovation.     3. Standard Operation and Basic
Maintenance Guidelines As high-frequency aerial work equipment, suspended platforms are prone to
steel rope wear, accessory aging and electrical system moisture damage after long-term outdoor
operation. Standardized operation and regular maintenance are the key to eliminating hidden dangers
and extending equipment service life. Basic daily inspection is required before operation: check the
stability of suspension mechanisms and counterweights, whether steel ropes are rusted or broken, the
sensitivity of safety locks, brakes and limit devices, and the integrity of platform bolts and
welds. Faulty equipment is prohibited from operation. Operators must strictly follow load standards,
overloading, eccentric loading and platform shaking are forbidden, and work shall be suspended in
strong wind weather. Daily maintenance focuses on wearing parts: regularly lubricate hoists and
transmission structures, clean dust on steel ropes and conduct anti-rust treatment; check the
waterproof and moisture-proof performance of circuits after rain or during idle periods to prevent
electric leakage and short circuits. Regular daily maintenance can effectively reduce failure rates

# Bridge Operator Console: Communication Tools Built to Help Organizations Endure and Thrive

Bridge Operator Console helps organizations on Microsoft Teams, RingCentral, Dialpad, Skype for
Business, and Cisco CUCM build clearer, more resilient communications that adapt as their needs
evolve. Phone-first teams get the visibility and control to direct calls with calm precision and
human judgment — sustaining the connections that let organizations succeed over the long run, no
matter what the day or the future brings.

With full call control, Agentic AI, AI-powered predictive transfer, related people lookups,
integrated messaging, SMS, intercom, and more, Bridge Operator Console goes far beyond traditional
call handling.

The latest generation, included in our Cloud Suite, requires no installation -- making setup
seamless and instant. Runs in any modern web browser with no installation required. Features MS
presence, call queue visibility, cherry picking, parking lot visibility, and more.

#### Modern Workplace Users
* **1. Chat First Users**: Native App (Teams, RingCentral, Dialpad, Jabber, Skype)
* **2. Meeting First Users**: Native App (Teams, RingCentral, Dialpad, Jabber, Skype)
* **3. Phone First Users:** Bridge Operator Console

Phone-first users excel as communicators, gatekeepers, and problem-solvers, ensuring professional
and efficient call handling by directing calls to the right person or department.

# Bridge Operator Console: Communication Tools Built to Help Organizations Endure and Thrive

Bridge Operator Console helps organizations on Microsoft Teams, RingCentral, Dialpad, Skype for
Business, and Cisco CUCM build clearer, more resilient communications that adapt as their needs
evolve. Phone-first teams get the visibility and control to direct calls with calm precision and
human judgment — sustaining the connections that let organizations succeed over the long run, no
matter what the day or the future brings.

With full call control, Agentic AI, AI-powered predictive transfer, related people lookups,
integrated messaging, SMS, intercom, and more, Bridge Operator Console goes far beyond traditional
call handling.

The latest generation, included in our Cloud Suite, requires no installation -- making setup
seamless and instant. Runs in any modern web browser with no installation required. Features MS
presence, call queue visibility, cherry picking, parking lot visibility, and more.

#### Modern Workplace Users
* **1. Chat First Users**: Native App (Teams, RingCentral, Dialpad, Jabber, Skype)
* **2. Meeting First Users**: Native App (Teams, RingCentral, Dialpad, Jabber, Skype)
* **3. Phone First Users:** Bridge Operator Console

Phone-first users excel as communicators, gatekeepers, and problem-solvers, ensuring professional
and efficient call handling by directing calls to the right person or department.

you source wholesale merchandise from **UK suppliers** faster than ever before.

Basic wholesale buyer membership is free, with the option of [upgrading to premium buyer
services][149] to access all listed supplier and wholesaler details. If you are a UK wholesale
supplier you can [list your business details free][150] and upgrade to premium services, which
include a number of trade tools that will increase your company's exposure to wholesale buyers
worldwide.

Thousands of trade buyers and wholesale UK suppliers are [joining eSources][151] every month, be
part of this growing trend and start profiting from our services.

* **Subscribe to Premium Buyer Membership** to get access to thousands of exclusive wholesale
  sources and websites.

#### For Trade Suppliers
* Are you a wholesaler or trade supplier? **Request a free listing** on eSources
* **Register for Premium Supplier Membership** and increase your business and products visibility to
  buyers worldwide.
* List products, receive orders, and reply to buy leads.
* Track your advertising performance
* Receive alerts on new buy requests
* List your company profile in up to 5 categories and target each profile to each category.
* Stay ahead of your competition.

#### Resources
* Access hundreds of [auction houses][154] and discover the latest clearance auctions in the UK
* Read [trade related articles][155] and enhance your sales skills.
* Research the selling potential of any product using the free eSources [Market Research
  Wizard][156].

#### New Wholesale Products

#### Register on eSources as a buyer, premium supplier or international supplier:

As a **B2B trade portal** we offer 4 registration options. If you are a retailer or trade buyer
looking to source **wholesale products**, stocklots or clearance lines from UK suppliers and
**wholesalers**, select the Trade Buyers registration option. **UK based suppliers, wholesalers,
importers, distributors and manufacturers** looking to reach trade buyers worldwide can list their
business using our **premium services**. If your business is based abroad but supplies to the UK
please use the [international supplier registration option][157]. Premium suppliers, wholesalers,
importers and manufacturers benefit from increased exposure and numerous trading tools to increase
sales:

#### Trade Buyers
* Free access to all premium suppliers
* Access to the latest **wholesale offers**
* View wholesale prices and place orders
* Contact **UK trade suppliers** directly
* List your requests for wholesale stock
* Receive quotes from relevant suppliers

* Post your wholesale company profile

#### International Suppliers

### Smart, Safe and Connected

Extronics designs and manufacturers a range of hazardous area solutions for your **Wireless, Real
Time Location System (RTLS), Asset Management **and** Backup Power** needs.

Over 30 years’ experience supporting our customers around the world!


#### Wireless

Extronics offers a comprehensive range of wireless solutions to extend your wireless network into
hazardous areas. Our iWAP range of purpose-built wireless enclosures are certified to ATEX, IECEx
and MET standards, with flexible power and data options, proprietary RF isolation, and a range of
standard antennas. Extronics has the expertise to deliver cost-effective wireless solutions tailored
to your hazardous area requirements.

[Learn more about our wireless solutions][40]

[Extronics RTLS hazardous area location tags][Extronics RTLS hazardous area location tags]

#### RTLS

Locate your people and assets for improved efficiency, productivity and worker safety.

Extronics offers a range of RTLS solutions suitable for use in hazardous areas and harsh industrial
environments.

[Learn more about our RTLS solutions][41]

[UHF tags and readers fro hazardous areas][UHF tags and readers fro hazardous areas]

#### Auto ID

Manage your assets efficiently in hazardous areas with passive RFID (Radio Frequency Identification
Devices) and barcode scanners.

Extronics range of intrinsically safe UHF (Ultra High Frequency) and barcode scanning solutions
helps you extend your asset management directly into your hazardous areas.

[Learn more about out Auto ID solutions][42]

[Ex power solutions][Ex power solutions]

# LINEAISETHEREUM

Linea is the Layer 2 network built from first principles to strengthen Ethereum and the entire ETH
economy.

[Explore the Ecosystem][29][Bridge to Linea][30]
* [[metamask-logo]][31]
* [[aave-logo]][32]
* [[1inch-logo]][33]
* [[chainlink-logo]][34]
* [[circle-logo]][35]
* [[ens-logo]][36]
* [[etherex]][37]

##### Trusted by Ethereum and Global Finance Leaders

## The Best ChainforETHCapital

### Where Ethereum Wins

Our mission goes beyond galactic scale. We’re also driving value back to Ethereum mainnet to make
ETH the most important digital asset in the world.

[Learn more][42]
Productive ETH Mechanics

### Every transaction will
### burn ETH, increasing Ethereum’s value
* 20% of fees burned
* ETH supply reduced, supporting scarcity and long-term value
* Strong economic alignment between Linea and Ethereum

Capital Efficiency

### Native staking on
### bridged ETH will fuel
### DeFi yield

Bridged ETH will be natively staked, and yield will be distributed to liquidity providers,
delivering the best risk-adjusted return on capital, and fueling Linea's DeFi ecosystem.

[tokenomics]
Tokenomics

### No Insiders,
### No Extraction,
### Just Ethereum

The LINEA token mirrors the ETH Genesis distribution.

[Learn more][43]
Ecosystem Council

### Ethereum’s Largest Ecosystem Fund Managed by Trusted Stewards

The majority of the LINEA token supply will be directed toward builders, users, public goods, and
Ethereum R&D—to be distributed by a consortium of Ethereum stewards.

[[consensys]][44][[ens]][45][[status]][46][[eigen]][47][[sharplink]][48]
[Learn more][49]
zkEVM Technology

### The Ethereum
### Equivalent L2

Linea is the only 100% proven zkEVM rollup committed to full Ethereum equivalence.
* Rapid settlement and ultra-low fees
* 10x ZK proving performance vs general zkVMs
* Compatible with the full Ethereum tooling and client stack
* Seamless evolution with Ethereum upgrades
* Jointly developed by Ethereum’s open-source community, including Consensys, ENS, and Status

[Start building][50]
Enterprise

### Enterprise-Grade Infrastructure for Global Finance

Linea leverages Consensys' decade long experience understanding and supporting sophisticated
financial instituions like Mastercard, Visa, JP Morgan, and multiple sovereign banks.
* Built for tokenization, payments, trading, and onchain settlement
* Seamless integration with major DeFi protocols, leading custodians, and tokenization platforms
* No DAO governance risk, ETH-aligned economics

[Work with us][51]

### [rectangle]BUILD[line][shield]
### [circle]ON LINEA

Linea is Ethereum-aligned infrastructure for apps, users, and institutions.

Start building on Linea, where Ethereum is strengthened with every block.

# LINEAISETHEREUM

Linea is the Layer 2 network built from first principles to strengthen Ethereum and the entire ETH
economy.

[Explore the Ecosystem][29][Bridge to Linea][30]
* [[metamask-logo]][31]
* [[aave-logo]][32]
* [[1inch-logo]][33]
* [[chainlink-logo]][34]
* [[circle-logo]][35]
* [[ens-logo]][36]
* [[etherex]][37]
* [[fireblocks-logo]][38]
* [[lido]][39]
* [[mastercard-logo]][40]
* [[Sharplink black]][41]

##### Trusted by Ethereum and Global Finance Leaders

## The Best ChainforETHCapital

### Where Ethereum Wins

Our mission goes beyond galactic scale. We’re also driving value back to Ethereum mainnet to make
ETH the most important digital asset in the world.

[Learn more][42]
Productive ETH Mechanics

### Every transaction will
### burn ETH, increasing Ethereum’s value
* 20% of fees burned
* ETH supply reduced, supporting scarcity and long-term value
* Strong economic alignment between Linea and Ethereum

Capital Efficiency

### Native staking on
### bridged ETH will fuel
### DeFi yield

Bridged ETH will be natively staked, and yield will be distributed to liquidity providers,
delivering the best risk-adjusted return on capital, and fueling Linea's DeFi ecosystem.

[tokenomics]
Tokenomics

### No Insiders,
### No Extraction,
### Just Ethereum

The LINEA token mirrors the ETH Genesis distribution.

[Learn more][43]
Ecosystem Council

### Ethereum’s Largest Ecosystem Fund Managed by Trusted Stewards

The majority of the LINEA token supply will be directed toward builders, users, public goods, and
Ethereum R&D—to be distributed by a consortium of Ethereum stewards.

[[consensys]][44][[ens]][45][[status]][46][[eigen]][47][[sharplink]][48]
[Learn more][49]
zkEVM Technology

### The Ethereum
### Equivalent L2

Linea is the only 100% proven zkEVM rollup committed to full Ethereum equivalence.
* Rapid settlement and ultra-low fees
* 10x ZK proving performance vs general zkVMs
* Compatible with the full Ethereum tooling and client stack
* Seamless evolution with Ethereum upgrades
* Jointly developed by Ethereum’s open-source community, including Consensys, ENS, and Status

[Start building][50]
Enterprise

### Enterprise-Grade Infrastructure for Global Finance

Linea leverages Consensys' decade long experience understanding and supporting sophisticated
financial instituions like Mastercard, Visa, JP Morgan, and multiple sovereign banks.
* Built for tokenization, payments, trading, and onchain settlement
* Seamless integration with major DeFi protocols, leading custodians, and tokenization platforms
* No DAO governance risk, ETH-aligned economics

[Work with us][51]

### [rectangle]BUILD[line][shield]
### [circle]ON LINEA

Linea is Ethereum-aligned infrastructure for apps, users, and institutions.

Start building on Linea, where Ethereum is strengthened with every block.

# Инструкции по настройке оборудования MikroTik

Вас интересует [настройка роутеров, коммутаторов][14] MikroTik?
На сайте вы найдёте примеры с объяснениями по созданию VPN туннелей ([L2TP][15], [PPTP][16],
[OpenVpn][17], [GRE][18], [IPSec][19] и другие). Также описаны детально возможности по быстрой
настройке с использованием [Quick Set][20]. А для увеличения безопасности сети есть инструкция
по конфигурации [Firewall][21] и защиты [DNS][22] и других сервисов от взлома. Есть статьи по
настройке [WI-Fi как простой точки доступа][23] и решения для большой компании с централизованным

## Our Story

### [Evolving with DJs since 1994]

For over 30 years, we've driven the evolution of DJ technology to expand creativity for artists
worldwide. Today, AlphaTheta draws on the DNA of Pioneer and Pioneer DJ, continuing our legacy of
innovation and engineering excellence.

In 1994, Pioneer launched the CDJ-500 – the world's first flat-top CD player with a turntable feel.
Combining digital precision with analog touch, it revolutionized DJing and marked the start of our
DJ business.

[1994][CDJ-500][145]

### [Defining the global club standard: CDJ & DJM series]

The CDJ and DJM series have defined the global club standard of DJ equipment for decades.In 2006,
the CDJ-1000MK3 achieved intuitive CD scratching through its exceptional jog wheel control, while
the DJM-800 introduced high-quality digital sound processing and more creative effects.Together,
they became the go-to setup for clubs around the world – shaping the experience of modern dance
music.

[CDJ-1000MK3][146]
[2006][DJM-800][147]

### [Expanding creative choices: DDJ & XDJ series]

As DJ culture evolved, so did we.In 2012, the DDJ-SX changed the game for controller DJs – combining
PC power and Serato software for a professional experience. In 2015, the XDJ-RX delivered
club-quality performance as a compact all-in-one device capable of playing tracks managed in
rekordbox directly from a USB drive.Both series continue to evolve – empowering DJs with new ways to
perform and express their creativity.

[2012][DDJ-SX][148]
[2015][XDJ-RX][149]

### [The next chapter: AlphaTheta]

In 2024, we launched our brand, AlphaTheta, to drive innovation.The rotary mixer, euphonia, delivers
an immersive sound that combines warmth and clarity, while the next-generation DJ player, the
CDJ-3000X, opens new horizons for professionals.From Pioneer to Pioneer DJ, and now to AlphaTheta,
our DNA of innovation and quality lives on.

[2024][euphonia][150]
[2025][CDJ-3000X][151]

We’re an electric cooperative that also delivers reliable fiber internet, phone, and propane
services to homes and businesses in rural communities in southern Michigan, northern Indiana, and
northwest Ohio.

## Smart Solutions for Rural Living
* [Electric][91]
  
  Member-owned, reliable electric services
  
  ##### Member-owned, reliable electric services
  
  MEC delivers dependable electric service designed for rural communities, with safety and
  reliability at the core. Like you, we live and work in rural southern Michigan, which means we
  understand the needs of people who live here. From smart outage response to personalized support,
  you’re never just a number with us.
  
  [ Learn About Electric Services ][92]
* [Fiber Internet][93]
  
  Fast, secure, reliable internet
  
  ##### Fast, secure, reliable internet
  
  MEC delivers high-speed fiber internet straight to your home, with no data caps, throttling, or
  hidden charges. MEC fiber includes Wi-Fi, parental controls, automatic hacker blocking, and
  network protection all at no additional charge. Plus, our local support team is just a call away
  when you need help.
  
  [ Learn About Fiber Services ][94]
* [Phone][95]
  
  Reliable home or business phone services
  
  
  ##### Reliable home or business phone services
  
  MEC phone service keeps you connected with clear, reliable voice quality—no dropped calls or poor
  signals. Enjoy affordable plans with unlimited local and long-distance calling, plus seamless
  integration with your existing internet service. Our local support team is here when you need
  help.
  
  [ Learn About Phone Services ][96]
* [Propane][97]
  
  Propane without the gimmicks
  
  ##### Propane without the gimmicks
  
  Our propane service makes life easier with features like autofill, tank monitoring, and consistent
  12-month pricing. You’ll never worry about running out—or being surprised by hidden fees and price
  increases . With local teams and a three-business-day delivery guarantee, comfort is always close
  by.
  
  
  [ Learn About Propane Services ][98]
* [Technology Center][99]
  
  Continuity and disaster recovery
  
  ##### Continuity and disaster recovery
  
  MEC's Technology Center provides secure, reliable colocation services with state-of-the-art
  infrastructure. Keep your data protected with redundant power, cooling, and top-tier security.
  
  [ Learn About Technology Center Services ][100]

## Smart Solutions for Rural Living
* [Electric][91]
  
  Member-owned, reliable electric services
  
  ##### Member-owned, reliable electric services
  
  MEC delivers dependable electric service designed for rural communities, with safety and
  reliability at the core. Like you, we live and work in rural southern Michigan, which means we
  understand the needs of people who live here. From smart outage response to personalized support,
  you’re never just a number with us.
  
  [ Learn About Electric Services ][92]
* [Fiber Internet][93]
  
  Fast, secure, reliable internet
  
  ##### Fast, secure, reliable internet
  
  MEC delivers high-speed fiber internet straight to your home, with no data caps, throttling, or
  hidden charges. MEC fiber includes Wi-Fi, parental controls, automatic hacker blocking, and
  network protection all at no additional charge. Plus, our local support team is just a call away
  when you need help.
  
  [ Learn About Fiber Services ][94]
* [Phone][95]
  
  Reliable home or business phone services
  
  
  ##### Reliable home or business phone services
  
  MEC phone service keeps you connected with clear, reliable voice quality—no dropped calls or poor
  signals. Enjoy affordable plans with unlimited local and long-distance calling, plus seamless
  integration with your existing internet service. Our local support team is here when you need
  help.
  
  [ Learn About Phone Services ][96]
* [Propane][97]
  
  Propane without the gimmicks
  
  ##### Propane without the gimmicks
  
  Our propane service makes life easier with features like autofill, tank monitoring, and consistent
  12-month pricing. You’ll never worry about running out—or being surprised by hidden fees and price
  increases . With local teams and a three-business-day delivery guarantee, comfort is always close
  by.
  
  
  [ Learn About Propane Services ][98]
* [Technology Center][99]
  
  Continuity and disaster recovery
  
  ##### Continuity and disaster recovery
  
  MEC's Technology Center provides secure, reliable colocation services with state-of-the-art
  infrastructure. Keep your data protected with redundant power, cooling, and top-tier security.
  
  [ Learn About Technology Center Services ][100]

  ### Tunnels/Construction Sites Solution
  
  Communication interconnection and safety monitoring are realized by wireless ad-hoc network
  technology.Wireless communication without wiring,emergency communication system,Anti-interference
  Wireless Ad Hoc Network Module In tunnels and construction sites where traditional cabling is
  difficult or impractical, wireless ad hoc network technology enables fast, flexible communication
  deployment. This solution provides cable-free wireless communication, emergency communication
  systems, and anti-interference MESH networking modules, ensuring stable data transmission,
  real-time monitoring, and enhanced on-site safety. It significantly improves coordination
  efficiency and emergency response in complex and dynamic work environments.
  ][96]
* [
  
  ### Ports/Wharfs/Islands Solution
  
  Equipment interconnection, transportation scheduling and safety management are realized through
  wireless ad-hoc network technology.Port Wireless Monitoring System,Shipborne networking
  equipment,Outdoor exploration wireless ad hoc network communication In ports, wharfs, and island
  environments where infrastructure may be limited or dispersed, wireless ad-hoc network technology
  enables efficient equipment interconnection, transportation scheduling, and safety management. The
  solution integrates a Port Wireless Monitoring System for real-time video surveillance and
  operational oversight, shipborne networking equipment to maintain stable communication at sea, and
  outdoor exploration wireless ad hoc network communication modules to support field operations in
  remote or harsh coastal environments. This system ensures flexible deployment, strong
  anti-interference performance, and seamless coordination across land and sea, significantly
  enhancing the intelligence and reliability of maritime logistics and port security.
  ][97]
* [
  
  ### Elevators/Ecological Agriculture/Aquaculture/Wireless Coverage Solution
  
  Realize equipment monitoring, data transmission and wireless coverage optimization through
  wireless ad-hoc network technology.Self-healing MESH network device,POE-powered wireless
  bridge,Smart City MESH Network Equipment Wireless Coverage and Monitoring Solution for Elevators,
  Agriculture, and Aquaculture In diverse environments such as elevators, ecological agriculture
  zones, aquaculture facilities, and remote rural areas, wireless ad-hoc network technology enables
  reliable equipment monitoring, efficient data transmission, and intelligent wireless coverage
  optimization. This solution integrates self-healing MESH network devices to ensure uninterrupted
  communication in dynamic or obstacle-prone environments. Through POE-powered wireless bridges, it
  simplifies deployment by combining power and data transmission in one cable. Additionally, Smart
  City MESH Network Equipment provides scalable and stable networking for intelligent sensing,
  automation, and environmental management, making it ideal for modern smart farming, vertical
  transport systems, and digital infrastructure in remote regions.
  ][98]

# TRID

TRID is an integrated database that combines the records from TRB’s Transportation Research
Information Services ([TRIS][23]) Database and the OECD’s Joint Transport Research Centre’s
International Transport Research Documentation ([ITRD][24]) Database. TRID provides access to 1.5
million records of transportation research worldwide.

[ Video New TRID Video Tutorial Series is available! ][25]

This series includes short videos on starting your transportation research with TRID as well as
basic and advanced search techniques to get the most out of the database.

Due to licensing restrictions, the TRID database, or any portion thereof, may not be used to train
any Large Language Model (LLM).

## Popular questions

### What is WiFi Map?

WiFi Map is an all-in-one app that offers a range of amazing features to help you stay connected no
matter where you are in the world.[Read more][37]

### What is Wifi Map Community?

WiFi Map is the world's largest WiFi community, dedicated to building a GLOBAL WIRELESS NETWORK to
provide free internet access to people around the world.[Read more][38]

### How to connect to a WiFi hotspot?

WiFi Map app provides you with detail information about public and private WiFi hotspots that have
been added by members of WiFi Map community.[Read more][39]

### Why are there no WiFi hotspots nearby?

WiFi Map is an app where people from all over the world voluntarily share information about
available WiFi locations to help each other quickly find FREE internet access. [Read more][40]

### Why isn't my neighbor's WiFi in the app?

WiFi Map is not supposed to detect WiFi hotspots. The app shows you information about public and
private WiFI locations that have been added by WiFi Map community. [Read more][41]

### What is $WIFI and how can it be used?

$WIFI is the name of WiFi Map's very own utility token, also known as a digital currency. It allows
us to reward our millions of contributors and give them access to the premium WiFi Map
services.[Read more][42]

### What is WiFi Map’s Airdrop?

Airdrop is WiFi Map app's events. We’re rewarding contributors who help to expand the WiFi network
with the new $WIFI token.[Read more][43]

### What is WiFi Map Referral Program?

Our referral program gives you the chance to earn $WIFI tokens while helping your friends save on
their eSIM purchases.[Read more][44]

## Popular questions

### What is WiFi Map?

WiFi Map is an all-in-one app that offers a range of amazing features to help you stay connected no
matter where you are in the world.[Read more][37]

### What is Wifi Map Community?

WiFi Map is the world's largest WiFi community, dedicated to building a GLOBAL WIRELESS NETWORK to
provide free internet access to people around the world.[Read more][38]

### How to connect to a WiFi hotspot?

WiFi Map app provides you with detail information about public and private WiFi hotspots that have
been added by members of WiFi Map community.[Read more][39]

### Why are there no WiFi hotspots nearby?

WiFi Map is an app where people from all over the world voluntarily share information about
available WiFi locations to help each other quickly find FREE internet access. [Read more][40]

### Why isn't my neighbor's WiFi in the app?

WiFi Map is not supposed to detect WiFi hotspots. The app shows you information about public and
private WiFI locations that have been added by WiFi Map community. [Read more][41]

us to reward our millions of contributors and give them access to the premium WiFi Map
services.[Read more][42]

with the new $WIFI token.[Read more][43]

their eSIM purchases.[Read more][44]

**Custom Wireless Communication Solutions**: We build custom wireless motherboard PCBA, Wi-Fi
modules, and mesh networking boards that support 2.4G/5.8G dual-band, Wi-Fi 6/7, MESH networking,
Qualcomm platforms, and OpenWrt customization. These are used in high-power NLOS transmission,
industrial roaming, vehicle/AGV systems, emergency response, IoT gateways, and other applications
where reliability is non-negotiable. We handle full OEM customization with complete transparency —
so overseas customers always know exactly where things stand. Here's what our typical OEM timeline
looks like, built around the things that matter most: speed, compliance, and control:

**1. Requirements Definition & Solution Alignment (1–3 business days)**
Our English-speaking engineering team sits down with you to go over specs, performance requirements,
mechanical details, compliance needs (CE, FCC, RoHS, etc.), and order volume. We then put together a
detailed proposal and quote so everyone's on the same page from day one.
**2. Sample Engineering & Validation (5–7 business days)**
We move fast on sample development and prototyping, and deliver test reports with performance,
compatibility, and reliability data. We'll go through as many revision cycles as it takes until the
samples match your requirements and get signed off.
**3. Pre-Production Preparation & Pilot Run (3–5 business days)**
Once the samples are approved, we start sourcing materials through our global supply chain (all
genuine parts, on schedule), set up the production line, and dial in the process parameters. A pilot
run of up to 500 units is then carried out to confirm process stability and product consistency
before we ramp up.
**4. Volume Production (7–20 business days, depending on order size)**
After the pilot run passes qualification, we kick off full-scale production on our automated lines
under ISO quality management. Every step is checked by dedicated QC staff and precision instruments.
We send daily production and test reports so you always have real-time visibility into progress and
quality.
**5. Final Inspection & Shipment (1–2 business days)**
Once production wraps up, we do a 100% final inspection and reliability test, issue certified test
reports, and get everything shipped through our global logistics network. All customs documents —
commercial invoices, packing lists, test certificates — are included to make international delivery
as smooth as possible.

We make the jump from prototype to full production as seamless as possible, with English-language
support at every stage so your OEM project runs efficiently and without headaches.

**Comprehensive After-Sales Support**: We know that good after-sales support is what makes or breaks
an international partnership. That's why we offer fast, professional, fully traceable post-sale
service designed to give you real peace of mind. Here's what that looks like: a 24/7 English tech
support hotline and online chat for quick help with product questions, troubleshooting, and
technical guidance; a solid warranty that covers free repairs, part replacements, or rework for
non-human-induced defects; a traceability system with unique batch codes on every shipment so issues
can be traced and resolved fast; on-site support and maintenance available for bulk orders
(depending on your region) to help with commissioning, troubleshooting, and process improvements;
and long-term spare parts availability so your maintenance and upgrade needs are covered well into
the future.

**Global Reach & Partnership Commitment**: Our products are used across industrial automation, smart
home, IoT, security communications, renewable energy, automotive electronics, medical devices,
emergency communications, and more. With a solid supply chain and global shipping network, we
deliver on time, keep costs in check, and back everything with reliable support. We're here to be
your go-to partner for PCBA and wireless communication motherboard manufacturing — plain and simple.

## Core technology

### Intelligent Distributed Mesh Ad Hoc Networking Technology

Equipped with an intelligent distributed networking protocol, devices automatically interconnect,
relay, and select optimal paths, eliminating the need for complex manual configuration. Multi-node
rapid linkage networking is simple and efficient to deploy. Link failures are automatically detected
and backup paths are automatically switched. Single-point device failures do not affect the overall
network operation, possessing strong network self-healing capabilities and ensuring more stable
long-term operation.

### Superior anti-interference & non-line-of-sight transmission

Optimized RF circuits and signal algorithms adapt to complex buildings and obstructed environments,
overcome the limitations of walls and obstacles, support non-line-of-sight long-distance
transmission, have industrial-grade anti-interference capabilities, support multi-node signal relay
forwarding, and provide long-distance, wide-area coverage; the device can achieve seamless roaming
switching, and the network is stable and continuous in mobile scenarios without lag or
disconnection.

### WiFi 6/WiFi 7 Core Technologies

Equipped with OFDMA + MU-MIMO technology and MLO multi-link aggregation technology for simultaneous
collaborative transmission, automatic switching upon disconnection results in a more stable network
and stronger fault tolerance. The RF algorithm has been comprehensively upgraded, significantly
enhancing signal penetration, long-distance coverage, and non-line-of-sight transmission
capabilities.

### Smart Anti-Interference Frequency Hopping Technology

With Dynamic Frequency Selection (DFS) and Adaptive Modulation and Coding (AMC), the system
automatically avoids interference-prone bands and optimizes transmission strategies in real time.
Even in harsh electromagnetic environments, it maintains stable transmission with packet loss rate
below 0.1%, ensuring zero lag and uninterrupted data for critical industrial applications.

### Industrial reinforcement & high-speed transmission

It adopts a multi-layer precision PCB design and is equipped with the WiFi6 high-speed transmission
protocol, featuring efficient and low-latency transmission with a maximum transmission rate of 2.4G.
It operates stably throughout the wide temperature range and all day long, supports concurrent
access of multiple terminals, and easily achieves full wireless coverage of the factory area,
providing strong, high-speed and reliable wireless networking support for industrial scenarios.

## Core technology

### Intelligent Distributed Mesh Ad Hoc Networking Technology

Equipped with an intelligent distributed networking protocol, devices automatically interconnect,
relay, and select optimal paths, eliminating the need for complex manual configuration. Multi-node
rapid linkage networking is simple and efficient to deploy. Link failures are automatically detected
and backup paths are automatically switched. Single-point device failures do not affect the overall
network operation, possessing strong network self-healing capabilities and ensuring more stable
long-term operation.

### Superior anti-interference & non-line-of-sight transmission

Optimized RF circuits and signal algorithms adapt to complex buildings and obstructed environments,
overcome the limitations of walls and obstacles, support non-line-of-sight long-distance
transmission, have industrial-grade anti-interference capabilities, support multi-node signal relay
forwarding, and provide long-distance, wide-area coverage; the device can achieve seamless roaming
switching, and the network is stable and continuous in mobile scenarios without lag or
disconnection.

### WiFi 6/WiFi 7 Core Technologies

Equipped with OFDMA + MU-MIMO technology and MLO multi-link aggregation technology for simultaneous
collaborative transmission, automatic switching upon disconnection results in a more stable network
and stronger fault tolerance. The RF algorithm has been comprehensively upgraded, significantly
enhancing signal penetration, long-distance coverage, and non-line-of-sight transmission
capabilities.

### Smart Anti-Interference Frequency Hopping Technology

With Dynamic Frequency Selection (DFS) and Adaptive Modulation and Coding (AMC), the system
automatically avoids interference-prone bands and optimizes transmission strategies in real time.
Even in harsh electromagnetic environments, it maintains stable transmission with packet loss rate
below 0.1%, ensuring zero lag and uninterrupted data for critical industrial applications.

### Industrial reinforcement & high-speed transmission

It adopts a multi-layer precision PCB design and is equipped with the WiFi6 high-speed transmission
protocol, featuring efficient and low-latency transmission with a maximum transmission rate of 2.4G.
It operates stably throughout the wide temperature range and all day long, supports concurrent
access of multiple terminals, and easily achieves full wireless coverage of the factory area,
providing strong, high-speed and reliable wireless networking support for industrial scenarios.
